facts.fact: Official tourism recommends Petit-Champlain for a Christmas visit.
Petit-Champlain lies below the fortifications at the base of Cap Diamant.
facts.excerpt: Nuzzled along the base of Cap Diamant, just below the fortifications of Old Québec

facts.fact: The steep stairs and nearby funicular connect upper and lower areas.
facts.excerpt: Tucked in a corner near the funicular are the escalier Casse-Cou (breakneck stairs) which steeply climb to the top of Cap Diamant
